description: This file defines utility methods and enums related to emoji handling, including skin tones, gender, and rendering checks.

classes.name: EmojiUtils
classes.description: Utility class for emoji-related operations, including skin tone and gender enums, and methods to check emoji labels and renderability.

methods.name: isLabelOfEmoji
methods.description: Checks if the given CharSequence is an emoji label based on its first character code point.

methods.name: isRenderable
methods.description: Determines if the emoji or text is renderable with the given Paint object, considering whether it is an emoji label.
